restaurantName: De la Gare - La Table des Suter
address: Avenue de la Gare 13, Lucens, 1522, Switzerland
bio: This elegant family-run institution opposite Lucens railway station always hits the spot thanks to its buzzy, friendly vibe and professional service. The carefully crafted repertory is rolled out in polished lunch and dinner menus. Some of its high-flying signature dishes include “Belles Demoiselles” (langoustines cooked in several ways with a Thai sauce), “Patte Noire de Bourgogne” poularde (young chicken) stuffed with truffles and a citrus fruit and chocolate extravaganza. Top-notch produce is enhanced by the know-how of its seasoned kitchen team. Savvy selection of Swiss wines, also available in magnums and half bottles. Pleasant guestrooms for overnight stays. An elegant interior and slick polished service for a gourmet experience – what’s not to like?...
pageTitle: De la Gare - La Table des Suter
